name: Multi-Tasking (Non-Technical) Staff and Havaldar (CBIC and CBN) Examination
department: Central ministries and offices; Havaldar in CBIC and CBN (Department of Revenue)
summary: Class 10 level recruitment for Multi-Tasking Staff (office support) and Havaldar posts in customs and narcotics. One computer-based exam in two sessions, plus a walking test and physical standards for Havaldar. Level 1 pay.

status.note: Held every year. The 2025 cycle was notified on 26 June 2025 (7,948 vacancies). The SSC calendar listed the 2026 notice for June 2026; check the SSC website for its release.

posts.name: Multi-Tasking Staff (Non-Technical)
posts.responsibilities: Office support: files, records, maintenance, dak, basic clerical help.

posts.name: Havaldar (CBIC and CBN)
posts.responsibilities: Field support in customs, GST and narcotics offices.
posts.notes: Walking test and physical standards apply.

relaxations.note: After deducting military service from actual age, as per notice.

age.summary: MTS: 18 to 25. Havaldar and a few MTS posts: 18 to 27. On 1 August of the exam year (2025 cycle: MTS born 2 Aug 2000 to 1 Aug 2007).

eligibility.physical: Havaldar only. Walking: men 1,600 m in 15 minutes; women 1 km in 20 minutes. Height: men 157.5 cm, women 152 cm (relaxable for Garhwalis, Assamese, Gorkhas and ST). Men chest 81 cm with 5 cm expansion. Women weight 48 kg (relaxable by 2 kg for the same groups).
eligibility.examVsPost: You can apply for MTS, Havaldar or both. Havaldar needs the physical tests.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: MTS closes at 25; Havaldar at 27. Physical tests for Havaldar.

stages.name: Computer-based exam, Session II
stages.notes: 45 minutes. Minus 1 mark per wrong answer.

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from the computer-based exam (both sessions must be qualified); Havaldar also needs PET/PST.
selection.languages: English, Hindi and 13 regional languages (including Telugu and Kannada) for Session I and the General Awareness section.

statistics.note: MTS and Havaldar vacancies for the 2025 cycle as reported; result published in 2026.

career.promotionNotes: Limited promotion; many MTS staff move up by passing departmental LDC exams or later SSC exams.

benefits.detail: CGHS where available, LTC, earned and half-pay leave, HRA or government quarters, NPS with the UPS option.

workLife.postings: Central offices across India, often in your region.

difficulty.rationale: Class 10 syllabus, but tens of lakhs apply. Havaldar adds an easy walking test.

ratings.rationale: Annual; regional state-wise vacancies; slow growth.

factors.note: The 2026 notice slipped beyond its calendar date.
